name: github-operations
description: Carries a GitHub pull request from open to merge, cleans up a Git repository without losing work, and brings the GitHub MCP server with it.

github_token.title: GitHub token
github_token.description: Personal access token the bundled GitHub MCP server sends as a Bearer header. Stored in your system keychain.

github_mcp_url.title: GitHub MCP server URL
github_mcp_url.description: Default exposes every toolset, including write and delete tools. Append /readonly, or use /x/<toolset>, to narrow it.
